name: forty_one_cats

caption: why does grandma keep 41 cats on the wall 🐈
logline: In a snowy village where nobody locks a door, a boy's grandma keeps forty-one cats on the wall facing out; on the coldest night he takes the one by his window up to his bed.
question: why tf does grandma keep 41 cats on the wall, facing out?
premise: Grandma keeps forty-one cats on the village wall, one every ten blocks, all facing out, and none may come in, even in the snow. 'They keep the QUIET ones out.' She got the first one the week the boy came to live with her. The neighbours don't even lock their doors. Once he heard a hiss under his window; Grandma said it was a cat. Tonight it's so cold he takes the cat by his window up to his bed.
twist: The cats are for him. Creepers hunt only players, and he's the only player in the village; creepers flee cats (vanilla). Grandma built the cat wall the week he arrived. Tonight there's a gap where his cat sat: a creeper walks through it, past the villagers' unlocked doors without a glance, straight to his window, and swells and hisses, while the cat sleeps by the fire, too far away to help. Cut on the hiss.
